correctness.rationale: After radical reduction, cancelling Möbius factors supported on the already recovered primes leaves a product whose unique smallest remaining divisor is the next prime q. Its coefficient is an l-adic unit and every other contribution has strictly larger l-adic order, giving nu_l(R_j-1)=a q nu_l(x). The Möbius sign is locally recoverable under the stated odd-l or 2-adic depth hypothesis. Exact rational-arithmetic checks agree throughout the stated finite range.

originality.rationale: The recent source arXiv:2609.18480 gives the one-step local radical identity, the binary plus-extractor, squarefree iterative stripping, and a separate Archimedean peeling mechanism, but not the normalized residual p-adic recursion here. Pomerance--Rubinstein-Salzedo provide the classical product/reduction ingredients without this recursion. Exact and synonymous searches found no equivalent theorem; the main residual risk is unindexed contemporaneous work because the motivating preprint is extremely recent.

value.rationale: The result upgrades a one-step local valuation into an exact prime-by-prime decoder from one cyclotomic evaluation, works uniformly at arbitrary suitable bases, yields all-index single-value corollaries at bases 3 and 4, and recovers every prime in a nonsquarefree index from one binary value even though the unnormalized binary plus-valuation is then identically 1.
